en: Color postcard showing an ornamental fountain with sculpted human figures on its central drum, set in a park with trees and benches. Behind the fountain stand stone ruins and an arched wall from the 16th century. The reverse side contains multilingual captions identifying the location and the fountain, along with standard postcard address lines and stamp boxes.
